patch_list: Disable analytics
Stops AppsFlyer from tracking installs and in-app events, and turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Sessions. Tuya's own usage statistics are left on.
GmsCore support
Makes "Sign in with Google" work. Signs in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so it needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Hide ads
Removes the Google ad banners and ad rows the app shows, such as the one above the Me menu.
Hide AI ask bar
Removes the "How can I help?" Tuya AI bar above the bottom navigation.
Hide Explore tab
Removes the Explore tab from the bottom navigation.
Hide My Orders
Removes the "My Orders" row from the Me tab.
Hide Plus button
Removes the "Plus" pill from the home header.
Hide Recommended for you
Removes the "Recommended for You" section and its cards (AI Notes and the rest) from the home screen.
Hide Rewards Hub
Removes the "Rewards Hub" row and its banner from the Me tab.
Hide Tuya AI Web Version
Removes the "Tuya AI Web Version" row from the Me tab.
